response.sql: WITH pair AS (SELECT o.mktnote AS m, AVG(f.feerate - f.rebrate) AS a FROM fees f JOIN orders o ON o.recordvault = f.orderslink GROUP BY o.mktnote), bench AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS b FROM pair) SELECT AVG(p.a) AS avg_net_fee_rate, AVG(p.a - bench.b) AS avg_excess FROM pair p, bench WHERE p.a > bench.b
